seed: Objects of type `wall` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [hazard] show mixed outcomes: no_change x3, w,x x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a global object such as a counter, HUD element or legend, read as state. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Blocks move four cells vertically; ACTION3 moves them apart and ACTION4 together, mirrored by board half.
Clicking an inactive marker arms it and recolours blocks to players; clicking a player disarms; armed arrows move the active marker.
Movement requires the destination 4x4 cell to be floor colour 5, reading walls and hazards directly from the frame.
The ACTION3 wall-width changes are HUD timing: width=(128*a+150)//300, counting every action; verified across all 30 transitions.
Hidden count is used only when the incoming frame equals the last predicted frame; otherwise use a HUD-derived default. Reset trigger and budget exhaustion remain unconfirmed.
